# Duplicate snippets

The setup snippet and both previews use the same Twig.

## File to copy

```twig {"filename":"badge.html.twig"}
<twig:Badge>Same content</twig:Badge>
```

## First preview

```twig {"preview":true}
<twig:Badge>Same content</twig:Badge>
```

## Second preview

```twig {"preview":true}
<twig:Badge>Same content</twig:Badge>
```
